title: Maria P NDE 8055
content: I was out at a bar-restaurant with a friend to celebrate Women's Day. We ordered our drinks and decided to stand at the bar to enjoy them. My friend received a call to go pick up her boyfriend just as the drinks were served, so she left. I was really dehydrated, but hadn't had any water yet. There was only the alcohol to drink. I had a sip of my drink and a few seconds later a second sip. It is normal for me, since I was a young girl, to have intense instincts and visualizations. I started having a strange feeling that something was going to happen to me. Chills ran up my body and I started feeling dizzy. I slowly started to walk towards a friend at the end of the bar. The room starts spinning, my heart rate was racing, and I could feel my senses slowing down. This was all in slow motion for me. As soon as I reached my friend, I said, 'Don't be scared, but something very bad is going to happen to me!' and I collapsed. They carried me out of the restaurant and I opened my eyes to see my friend and her boyfriend holding me. That's when I whispered with all my might to him, 'George, please do not be scared but I'm leaving!' Again, I collapsed. He carried me downstairs. According to George, he was holding me straight up, standing with one hand wrapped around my waist and the other hand in a headlock. Suddenly he said I slipped right through his arms like a snake. His grip was so strong that he cannot understand or believe that happened. I fell on the floor as my tongue rolled to my throat. At that point, he could not feel my heartbeat or my breath. I suddenly saw myself floating above my body. I was looking downwards at my body, but couldn't see the people around me. My body looked empty. There was light everywhere that was so breathtaking, magnificent, and absolutely beautiful. It was light like I have never experienced before. Words cannot describe it. The light was intelligent, it was endless, and it was communicating with me. I felt perfection, Bliss, Love, Love, Love, and again, words cannot describe the extent of these feelings. I was so HAPPY, that I did not want to leave. Suddenly, I looked down at my body and asked, 'Why am I so happy when obviously something bad happened to me?' I told the Light that, 'I do not want to leave, I want to stay here with you.' Then the Light replied, 'But it's not your time!' We were communicating without actually talking with our voices. It was inner talk. Then I started to feel vibrations from afar. They were coming closer and closer until suddenly, I felt a strong vibration that caused my entire body to jerk up and hit ground again. It felt like my soul entered my body. I opened my eyes and saw my friend and George crying over me. He was screaming and yelling that I had gone. Can you just imagine their surprise when I opened my eyes? I whispered to them, 'don't worry I am ok. Everything is OK.' Now, I know for certain that Life doesn't end here. I know that where we are headed, after life on Earth, is Perfection. I know that there cannot possibly be bad spirits since the one and only Source is LOVE. The 'bad' spirits are an Ego experience. Since the experience, my instincts are stronger than ever. I am capable of communicating with the other dimensions. I have the gift of Healing (such as diseases, emotional pains). I can easily align my energy with plants, animals, and people and know what they are feeling. I can see past and future events. I've also discovered something extraordinary. My heart is like a 'telephone.' When someone on the other side of this world, whom I haven't spoken to for years or someone I don't even personally know is thinking of me, or is experiencing challenges in their life, my heart beat changes. I hear the name of the individual and suddenly I am tapped into their 'consciousness.' I know what is happening and what they are feeling. Since my body no longer desires meat, my body heals itself very quickly and with ease. I've had three mini-tricuspid atresias, a heart surgery where I was up and out in 3 days. The doctors could not believe it. I was also in a major car accident where the doctors could not believe that I survived and declared it a miracle.

arrival.other_being_detail: The experiencer describes an intelligent, endless Light that communicated with her and told her, 'But it's not your time!'

environment.environment_other_detail: She reports 'light everywhere' that was breathtaking, magnificent, beautiful, intelligent, and endless.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: She felt vibrations approaching, then a strong vibration that caused her body to jerk up; it felt like her soul entered her body.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Collapse after drinking alcohol while very dehydrated; witnesses reported no heartbeat or breath and tongue rolled back.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE occurred at the scene; she then experienced pervasive intelligent light and telepathic communication, was told 'it's not your time,' then returned via strong vibrations.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Post-NDE claims: communication with other dimensions; healing abilities; increased empathy with plants/animals/people; seeing past and future events; 'heart is like a telephone'—heartbeat changes and she hears a name and becomes 'tapped into' another person's consciousness; reports rapid healing and loss of desire for meat.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Don't be scared, but something very bad is going to happen to me!”; “George, please do not be scared but I'm leaving!”; “I do not want to leave, I want to stay here with you.”; “But it's not your time!”; “Everything is OK.”
